description: One Fineract service user per agent, with a role that grants only what the agent's MCP tools need (python/profiles.toml). The bootstrap creates the roles and users, keeps each role's permissions exactly as listed here, and checks on every run that each agent is refused (HTTP 403) outside its role.

identity.description: Looks up the client and their identity documents.

decision.description: Reads the applicant's history and the loan products; never writes.

writeback.description: Creates the client, their identity document and the loan application. Approval stays with a human.

intake.description: Reads the client and the loan products on offer.
